Contact page prints 515-336-6001 and info@beebedrainandsewer.com as the business phone and email. The ribbon address is the chamber office, not the Clive suite, and the company site does not restate the opening date. The Grimes chamber page uses the same August 5, 2026 date and welcomes the company to the community. No publication date was printed, and the opened page still presents the event as scheduled even though that date is before the research date. Beebe Drain and Sewer is not in baseline_excluded.tsv.
